items.title: Minimum Support Price for Rabi: Marketing Season 2027-28
items.summary: Strengthening Price Assurance, Procurement and Farmer Access 29 OCT 2026 11:06AM by PIB Delhi Minimum Support Price (MSP) serves as an important mechanism for providing price assurance to farmers and supporting informed decisions on agricultural planning and investment.

facts.text: On 30 September 2026, the Government approved increased MSPs for all mandated Rabi crops for the Rabi Marketing Season (RMS) 2027-28 , with an estimated ₹ 90,962 crore to be paid to farmers for 324 lakh metric tonnes (MT) of produce.
Procurement of six Rabi crops increased from 2,302 lakh metric tonnes (LMT) during 2004-05 to 2013-14 to 3,921 LMT during 2014-15 to 2025-26.
Correspondingly, MSP payments rose from ₹ 2.65 lakh crore to ₹ 8.36 lakh crore .
The productivity gains were complemented by assured procurement through the FPO at the Minimum Support Price (MSP) of ₹ 4,886 per quintal (2025–26 season).
